answer: Each epoch, every agent's action trace gets embedded into one latent space and clustered right at emission time. A sudden gale of fresh identities collapsing into a single high-density blob on the same behavioral mesa, near-identical in timing, focus, and output, is treated as one sybil fan and the whole cluster's rewards merge, so minting thousands costs the same as one. Honest diversity spreads across a wider horizon and escapes the flag.
